content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Back in 2006, I planned to automate some lighting in my renovated house and purchased a [product_name]. However, I didn’t get to the project until now. I’ve discovered that my old [product_name] software ([version_no]) won’t install on Windows 10 because of Java errors. What steps should I take to obtain an updated version that works? Thank you in advance. (A photo of the box and contents is attached.)

Welcome to the forum. Try following the tutorial found on the [company_name] website: How do you install a downloaded upgrade for [product_name] software? You can get the latest version ([version_no]) from the same site under demo software, upgrades, or drivers. Make sure you select the version that matches your system (32-bit or 64-bit). Once downloaded, run "Setup.exe" as administrator.
Thank you, that solved my issue! The installation went smoothly and I can now access my old project files without any trouble. Cheers.

analysis.insight_summary: An outdated version of [product_name] software was incompatible with Windows 10 due to Java errors. The primary user experience issue was the inability to install older software on recent systems. With clear instructions and an updated software download, the user successfully regained access to previous projects.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [product_name] software to install and work seamlessly under Windows 10, including support for older project files without compatibility problems.
